ambiguities.source_text: Create a data field to show how much capital is paid off each month
ambiguities.ref: df['Monthly Capital Payment'] = df['Monthly Payment'] * (df['% of Monthly Repayment going to Capital'] / 100)
ambiguities.intent: Monthly capital payment is monthly payment times the capital percentage divided by 100.

ambiguities.source_text: how many months are needed to pay off the entire debt (whole months only)
ambiguities.ref: df['Months to Payoff'] = df.apply(lambda row: math.ceil(row['Capital Repayment Remaining'] / row['Monthly Capital Payment']), axis=1)
ambiguities.intent: Ceil initial capital divided by monthly capital payment to obtain whole payment months.
